title: Bāhira (tayo)
text: 3-8 Rūpā bhikkhave aniccā || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā aniccā || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || (59) Bāhira2 3-8 Rūpā bhikkhave dukkhā || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā dukkhā || || (60) Bāhira3 3-8 Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā aniccā || || 9 Evam passam || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Saṭṭhi-peyyālaṃ samattaṃ || || Tassuddānam || || Chandenaṭṭhārasā honti || Atītena ca dve nava || Yadaniccāṭṭhārasā vuttā || Tayo ajjhatta-bāhirā || Peyyālo saṭṭhiko vutto || Buddhenādiccabandhunā ti || || Suttantāni saṭṭhi || || [page 157] XXXV. 187. 2] SAMUDDA-VAGGO TATIYO 157 CHAPTER III SAMUDDA-VAGGO TATIYO
